newsitem.title: USA: Forrester Research says files for 2 mln shr IPO.
newsitem.headline: Forrester Research says files for 2 mln shr IPO.

text.p: Forrester Research Inc, a research firm which helps clients assess the impact of technology on their businesses, said on Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange for a two million share initial public offering.
The company said in a statement it estimated that the offering price would be around $13 to $15 per share.
Goldman Sachs & Co and Robertson, Stephens & Co were managing the deal, it said. Forrester said it expected to offer them another 300,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
A preliminary prospectus was due out by early November, it said.
